supported: In the DELTATRACK 2021 L. fuscus panel, same-individual/tag centered GPS-altitude shape persists in low-speed records in overlapping 100m cells, under a date-permutation null.
The flight-associated centered-shape identity is not uniquely confined to records classified as flying by speed proxy.
2021 tags and birds are one-to-one; the barometric-height channel is constant zero; the observational mechanism remains unresolved.
not_supported: The original flight identity signal is entirely GPS tag noise.
This stationary control measures a fixed physical ground level or calibrated tag error.
The stationary and flight null-calibrated score magnitudes are directly comparable as biological effect sizes.
The 8-bird L. argentatus descriptive score is inferentially positive or negative.
Individual behavioral strategy, resource partitioning, or central-place causation is proven.

next_boundary: A truly independent altitude channel, cross-tag same-individual measurements, or validated matched micro-perch physical elevation is needed to distinguish tag error from individual site fidelity. A speed/behaviour-matched flight contrast can test an additional ecological alternative but cannot solve tag-bird aliasing alone.
